card.text: Explore Vesta with Dawn imagery and its measured terrain, giant impact basins, and rocky surface.

introduction.text: Vesta is a rocky asteroid in the main belt between Mars and Jupiter. NASA’s Dawn spacecraft mapped its surface, revealing giant impact basins, equatorial troughs, and a diverse volcanic crust.

normal.title: FC natural-color composite
normal.summary: The 650, 550 and 430 nm bands approximate visible color. Bright terrain clips to white; shadows and color offsets remain.

ratios.title: Clementine-style color composite
ratios.summary: Published false-color Dawn filter ratios emphasize spectral differences. Source seams and missing coverage remain visible.

elevation.title: HAMO digital terrain model
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 255 km sphere. Polar gaps are interpolated; those areas are not stereo measurements.
